if: the supplier and recipient are officers or directors of one another's businesses, legally recognised partners, employer and employee, members of the same family, one controls the other, both are controlled by a third person, or together they control a third person
or either directly or indirectly owns, controls or holds twenty-five per cent or more of the outstanding voting stock or shares of both of them
or one is the sole agent, sole distributor or sole concessionaire of the other
then: they are RELATED PERSONS, s.15(1) does not apply, and the value falls to be determined under s.15(4) in the prescribed manner
note: The employer-employee limb is the one that catches ordinary businesses — a supply to a director or an employee is a related-party supply, and its transaction value is NOT automatically the taxable value. The twenty-five per cent figure is the threshold stated in the Act as updated 31-08-2021.
